cycle_note: JSON cycle means in-game focus loop; browser-level Tab must remain escapable. Only modal traps until Esc/cancel. Native select arrows follow platform; never override IME/composition.
global_rules: hover does not steal keyboard focus
held key at focus transfer ignored until release
do not move focus merely because an announcement arrives
do not skip inaccessible reason when disabled control is skipped

composition.meta_pages: global_meta_nav -> global_meta_toolbar -> current screen local group; unknown adds meta.lookup near persistent banner; no Tab loop at browser boundary
composition.battle: active state chooses battle/battle_unknown/battle_terminal; log expansion is inline; growth_dialog is the only modal scope
composition.conditional_controls: skip absent/disabled action; retain adjacent reason/detail; pending lookup appears only with retained operation
composition.gamepad_boundary: end-to-start graph edge applies to in-game logical D-pad focus only, not mandatory browser Tab capture

scene_entry.battle: ux.battle.heading then first relevant visible control; pending -> lookup
scene_entry.meta: page heading programmatic focus once after user navigation; never on passive refresh
scene_entry.terminal: announce outcome once; do not trigger route automatically
